📖 How to use

  1. Pick the platform you are posting to.
  2. Type or paste your post.
  3. Watch the live bar: green means fits, red means over the limit.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which platform limits are included?

X/Twitter 280, Threads 500, Instagram caption 2200, Facebook post 63206, LinkedIn post 3000, TikTok caption 4000, YouTube title 100, YouTube description 5000, Pinterest pin 800.

Does it count words too?

Yes — characters, characters without spaces, and words are all shown live.

Are these limits current?

They reflect published platform limits as of 2026. Platforms change specs occasionally; the post composer itself is the final authority.
